abilities.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points: The Attacks characteristic of its Crushing Iron Feet is 3. It has a Control characteristic of 5.

abilities.name: EVERYONE ABOARD!
abilities.declare: Pick up to 1 friendly INFANTRY HERO and up to 1 friendly non- reinforced , non- HERO INFANTR y unit that have not been deployed.
abilities.effect: Set up those units in reserve as this unit’s passengers . They have now been deployed.

abilities.name: THIS IS YOUR STOP, MAGGOTS!
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, Any Charge Phase
abilities.declare: Pick this unit’s passengers to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Set up each target wholly within 6" of this unit and more than 9" from all enemy units. In addition, the targets’ melee weapons have Charge (+1 Damage) for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: ENEMY OF THE THRONE
abilities.effect: Add 1 to hit rolls and wound rolls for units in this Regiment of Renown for attacks that target a SENTENCED unit.

abilities.name: ETHEREAL
abilities.effect: Ignore negative modifiers to save rolls for units in this Regiment of Renown .

abilities.name: COLLECT THE TITHE
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick the GOTHIZZAR HARVESTER in this Regiment of Renown to use this ability, then pick a NON-HERO INFANTRY unit (friendly or enemy) within its combat range to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. If the roll equals or exceeds the target’s Health characteristic, 1 model in the target unit is slain, then give the unit using this ability 1 bone-tithe point .

abilities.name: SOUL TAX
abilities.declare: Pick the Mortisan Ossifector in this Regiment of Renown to cast this spell, then: Pick a friendly unit, excluding units in this Regiment of Renown, to be the target. Pick a unit in this Regiment of Renown to be the recipient . The target and the recipient must be wholly within 12" of and visible to the caster. Then, make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Until the start of your next turn: The target has a maximum control score of 1. Add 1 to hit rolls and wound rolls for the recipient ’s combat attacks .

abilities.name: REBUILD ON THE MARCH
abilities.declare: Pick the Gothizzar Harvester in this Regiment of Renown to use this ability if it has 6 bone-tithe points . Then, pick another unit in this Regiment of Renown that has been destroyed to be the target.
abilities.effect: Reset the Gothizzar Harvester ’s bone-tithe points to 0. Then, set up a replacement of the target unit with half the number of models (rounding up) wholly within 9" of the Gothizzar Harvester and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: THE DECREE OF NAGASH
abilities.declare: Pick the friendly Vokmortian in this Regiment of Renown to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn, each time your opponent declares a FIGHT ability for the target, unless they spend 1 command point as a reaction, that FIGHT ability has no effect. Designer’s Note: That FIGHT ability does not count as a command.

abilities.name: REINFORCE PAVISE
abilities.declare: If the Mortek Crawler in this Regiment of Renown is wholly within 12" of and visible to the friendly Mortisan Ossifector in this Regiment of Renown, pick that Mortisan Ossifector to cast this spell, pick that Mortek Crawler to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Until the start of your next turn, the target has WARD ( 5+ ) .

abilities.name: MASKED IN PLAIN SIGHT
abilities.declare: This unit must be deployed using this ability.
abilities.effect: Set up this unit in reserve incognito . It has now been deployed. Friendly incognito units are destroyed at the end of the fifth battle round and not at the start of the fourth battle round

abilities.name: BAIT AND SWITCH
abilities.declare: This unit can use this ability if it is incognito . Pick this unit and a friendly INFANTRY HERO to be the targets. One target must be incognito and the other must be on the battlefield.
abilities.effect: Set up the incognito target wholly within 6" of the other target and not in combat . Then, remove the other target from the battlefield and set it up in reserve incognito . If this unit is destroyed, before removing it from play, set up the friendly incognito unit wholly within 6" of a battlefield edge and not in combat.

abilities.name: FORCEFUL COMMAND
abilities.declare: Pick a visible friendly unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Until the start of your next turn: The target cannot use MOVE abilities. The target’s melee weapons have Anti-charge (+1 Rend) .

abilities.name: BATTLE DAMAGED
abilities.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points: The Attacks characteristic of its Crushing Iron Feet is 3. It has a Control characteristic of 5.

abilities.name: MERCENARY ATTITUDES
abilities.declare: Pick another friendly NON-UNIQUE unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Pick 1 of the following effects to apply until the start of your next turn and while the target is wholly within 12" of this unit: You can re-roll run rolls for the target. Add 1 to charge rolls for the target. The target cannot be targeted by shooting attacks . Add 1 to wound rolls for the target’s combat attacks . Add 10 to the target’s control score .

abilities.name: BULWARK OF THE NECROPOLIS
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with a unit in this Regiment of Renown to be the target.
abilities.effect: Subtract 2D6 from the target’s control score for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: DEATHLESS MONSTROSITY
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.effect: Heal (3) this unit

abilities.name: SKELETAL SPLINTERING
abilities.declare: This spell can be cast by the same WIZARD more than once per phase. Pick the Arkhan the Black in this Regiment of Renown to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them that has not been picked to be the target of this spell this turn to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Roll a number of dice equal to the number of models in the target unit. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on that unit.

abilities.name: UNHOLY SACRAMENTS
abilities.effect: Add 1 to the number of dice rolled when making banishment rolls for the Arkhan the Black in this Regiment of Renown, to a maximum of 3.

abilities.name: ENDLESS WANDERING
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Enemy Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a unit in this Regiment of Renown that is not in combat to use this ability.
abilities.effect: That unit can use the ‘ Normal Move ’ ability as if it were your movement phase.

abilities.name: OMINOUS FOG
abilities.effect: Units in this Regiment of Renown are not visible to enemy units more than 12" from them while they are wholly within 9" of the Treelord in this Regiment of Renown.

abilities.name: SOULPIKE
abilities.declare: Pick the Neferata in this Regiment of Renown to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Until the start of your next turn, each time the target uses a CHARGE ability, immediately after that ability has been resolved, roll a number of dice equal to the unmodified charge roll for that ability. For each 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

abilities.name: PREMEDITATED DEMISE
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit within 12" of the Neferata in this Regiment of Renown to be the target.
abilities.effect: Until the start of your next turn, ward rolls cannot be made for damage points inflicted on the target by attacks made by units in this Regiment of Renown.

abilities.name: THE BLOOD QUEEN’S WILL
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit contesting an objective that the Neferata in this Regiment of Renown is contesting to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 2-5, subtract 10 from the control score of the target for the rest of the turn. On a 6, the target has a maximum control score of 1 for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: INCUBATION PERIOD
abilities.declare: This ability must be used to deploy this Regiment of Renown .
abilities.effect: Set up the units in this Regiment of Renown in reserve festering within . They have now been deployed.

abilities.name: BURSTING WITH LIFE
abilities.effect: If a friendly non- NURGLE’S GIFT unit would be destroyed, before the last model is removed from play, roll a dice. Add 1 to the roll for each other friendly non- NURGLE’S GIFT unit that has been destroyed this battle. On a 5+, pick a friendly unit that is festering within and set it up wholly within 6" of that model. It can be set up in combat .

abilities.name: PROJECTILE VOMIT
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
abilities.declare: Pick this unit to use this ability if it has not used a RAMPAGE ability this turn. Then, pick a point on the battlefield within 6" of this unit and pick all other units (friendly and enemy) within 3" of that point to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that target equal to the roll.

abilities.name: BELLOWING MOCKERY
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick this unit to use this ability if it has not used a RAMPAGE ability this turn, then pick an enemy unit within this unit’s combat range to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, subtract 1 from hit rolls for the target’s attacks for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: WHAT’RE YOU LOOKIN’ AT?
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
abilities.declare: Pick this unit to use this ability if it charged this turn and has not used a RAMPAGE ability this turn. Then, pick an enemy unit within 9" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll 2D6. This unit can move a number of inches equal to the roll. It can pass through enemy models and must end that move in combat with the target.

abilities.name: GHOSTLY PATHS
abilities.declare: This spell can be cast by the same WIZARD more than once per phase. Pick the Lady Olynder in this Regiment of Renown to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly unit in this Regiment of Renown that is wholly within 12" of them, that is not in combat and that has not been picked to be the target of this spell this turn to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: INSUBSTANTIAL
abilities.effect: Ignore negative modiers to save rolls for units in this Regiment of Renown

abilities.name: HARVESTERS OF SORROW
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with a unit in this Regiment of Renown to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target cannot use commands for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: STALKING BLADES
abilities.declare: Pick the Mannfred von Carstein in this Regiment of Renown to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Inflict 1 mortal damage on the target for each other enemy unit within 3" of the target.

abilities.name: ENGULFING SHADOWS
abilities.effect: Each time a unit in this Regiment of Renown is set up , add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of that unit’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: COVER OF NIGHT
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick 1 friendly unit in this Regiment of Renown that is not in combat to be the target.
abilities.effect: Remove that unit from the battlefield and set it up again more than 6" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: VITIATING VAPOURS
abilities.effect: Subtract 1 from ward rolls for enemy units while they are within 12" of the Corpse Cart in this Regiment of Renown .

abilities.name: LEGEND AMONG GRAVEROBBERS
abilities.declare: Pick the Corpse Cart in this Regiment of Renown to use this ability if it is within 3" of the Deadwalker Zombies unit in this Regiment of Renown. Then, pick each enemy INFANTRY , CAVALRY and BEAST unit within 12" of the Corpse Cart to be the targets.
abilities.effect: For each target that had any models slain this turn, you can return D3 slain models to the Deadwalker Zombies unit in this Regiment of Renown.
